parts.name: Blade Handle Set
parts.Basic_description: This part is one of the two blade-handle assemblies of the scissors, made of stainless steel, combining a sharp blade and a handle loop.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as one half of the cutting mechanism, providing both the cutting edge and one handle for gripping and applying force.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the pivot joint relative to the other blade-handle set to perform the cutting action.

parts.name: Blade Handle Set
parts.Basic_description: This is the second blade-handle assembly of the scissors, also made of stainless steel, forming the complementary half of the cutting pair.
parts.Functional_description: It works in conjunction with the first blade-handle set to create a shearing action for cutting materials.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots around the central joint opposite to the first blade-handle set, enabling the opening and closing motion.

parts.name: Decoration (Other)
parts.Basic_description: This part is a decorative or protective element, possibly a plastic coating or accent on the scissors.
parts.Functional_description: It provides aesthetic appeal or additional comfort, but does not contribute directly to the cutting function.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move relative to the main body of the scissors.
